name: EOD 2026-10-09
body:
> Eod · Summit Az · 2026-10-09

Friday. Summit AZ schema cleanup and fixture page rewrites.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Removed About page schema that listed unverified payment methods, a blank license, a broken logo and old links.
- Turned off Article schema on 149 service, city and legal pages in Rank Math; blog posts keep it.
- 24 pages showed login names ("kim", "scott-admin") as author; changed to "Summit Plumbing Pros".
- Removed the "$$" price claim from 123 city pages.
- 16 "crawled, not indexed" URLs: 10 are feeds and system files; of 6 real pages, drain cleaning Tempe now indexed, Queen Creek and Scottsdale drain not recrawled since Sep 25, and 3 fixture installation pages were copies.
- Rewrote fixture installation Tempe, Gilbert and Apache Junction with local facts from city websites (approved first), 2 links each; now 13 to 17% similar to other city pages (was up to 77%), banned claims removed.
- Removed inner links that split clickable cards on 4 fixture pages (Queen Creek broken since Sep 25).
- Gilbert page: cut generic filler and added 4 more Town of Gilbert facts; EPA numbers now appear once.

# Follow-ups
- Home warranty page: keep or remove decision.
- Oct 23: check Google for schema issues and whether rewritten pages are indexed.
- Same generic-text review for Tempe and Apache Junction fixture pages.
- Ask Scott about common fixture problems, standard install checks, and customer-bought fixtures.
- Request indexing for the 4 fixture pages and the Queen Creek and Scottsdale drain pages.
